## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change makes possible. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List checks actually executed and their outcomes. Explain anything not verified.
For design-only changes, check links and consistency with the proposed MVP.

## Policy, milestones, and recovery

Reference applicable AGENTS.md rule IDs. Record material exceptions with their
reason, impact, and mitigation, or state that none are needed.

Include the checkpoint commit(s), feature branch, and milestone result. Explain
recovery constraints for data, deployments, or external effects when applicable.

## Scope and documentation

- [ ] The change is focused and its status (planned or implemented) is clear.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private project memory, or execution artifacts are included.
- [ ] Applicable AGENTS.md requirements were checked and exceptions recorded.
- [ ] PROJECT.md reflects material decisions and milestone progress when relevant.
- [ ] Required review gates are satisfied before merge; new code revisions receive relevant checks again.
